notes: IMDirector (Director) / IMD on Robinhood Chain 4663. IMDPhysicalHook constructor is (IPoolManager poolManager_, address initialOwner, address initialFactory) = [$poolManager, $owner, $factory]; the hook refuses a zero manager or factory and validates flags 0x2040 (beforeInitialize + afterSwap, no return deltas) in its constructor, matching getHookPermissions. The token takes no constructor arguments, mints exactly 1e27 once to its deployer (the factory), has no owner, mint, pause, blacklist or transfer tax; the factory's 80/10/10 split and the 2500 IMD opening cap are launch policy, not manifest fields, and initialPrice is written as the launch facts give it. pool.fee 12500 is the real LP fee the hook initializes with; the hook takes no fee and returns a zero delta. beforeInitialize accepts only the PoolManager with sender == launchFactory, returns its selector and never binds or enables; counterfactual initialization of the predicted key reverts. Activation protocol unchanged: poolBound=false and enabled=false at deployment; only the explicit $owner calls bindPool once with the exact initialized Director/IMD key, the operator connects the gateway, then the owner calls setEnabled(true). The factory and tx.origin never gain owner rights. afterSwap emits RelayTriggered for relay 4 only from the signed BalanceDelta on the bound pool: IMD-input buys ON, sells OFF, minimum 0.05 IMD inclusive, 10 s global cooldown, 120 s TTL; foreign, unbound, disabled, small and cooldown swaps return the selector with zero delta. Imported audit, all reproduced against the arriving code and already corrected in this tree: (1) bindPool now reads slot0 and reverts PoolNotInitialized for a key the PoolManager never initialized, so a mistyped key cannot consume the one-shot bind (regression testMistypedInitializedKeyCannotConsumeCorrectBinding); (2) the PoolManager is a constructor argument written $poolManager, no compiled constant, so the protected floor passes wherever the verifier builds its manager (test/admission reproduces Hook, Owners, OwnToken and Token floors, 16 cases in both token orders, no skips); (3) renounceOwnership is overridden to revert RenounceDisabled, so administration moves only by Ownable2Step transfer and acceptance (test in IMDPhysicalHook.t.sol and regression testFactoryAndOriginNeverGainActivationRights). (4) and (5) are informational: the global first-eligible-swap-wins cooldown is SPEC behaviour and owner-tunable via setRule (threshold and cooldown), no change made; the scope note reports no defect. Checks on this commit with FOUNDRY_FUZZ_SEED=0xc593...0917: forge build clean; forge test 98 passed, 0 failed; the two real-LaunchFactory fork rehearsals against chain 4663 (RH_RPC) also pass in both token orders with 80/10/10, bind, enable, buy and sell commands. Deploy by mining a CREATE2 salt for flags 0x2040 with the final constructor arguments. No launch ID, token or hook has been deployed by this project; addresses, PoolKey and poolId come from the deployment receipts after admission. Keep relay reactions disabled until the owner has verified the Initialize event key, bound it and accepted the gateway.
